composition_rules: Speedup factors do not multiply automatically; optimizations can remove the same bottleneck or contend for the same resources.
Cache identity includes model, tokenizer, positions, masks, precision, adapters and committed state; similar strings are insufficient.
Approximate draft work can compose with exact target verification. Approximate target work requires a separate correctness argument.
Training or architecture changes require both a same-checkpoint execution comparison and a separate matched-resource quality comparison.
Charge training, calibration, metadata, copies, certificate computation, fallbacks, rejected work, queueing and recovery; inspect adverse trajectories.
Distribution preservation does not imply identical RNG traces or semantic answer correctness; greedy parity alone does not validate sampling.

coverage.adoption_rule: Catalog descriptions never enable runtime features. Only explicit reviewed adapter bindings are executable after normal admission.
gaps: No exhaustive patent or unpublished-work review
Most author results are not independently replicated locally
Hardware-specific and emerging variants need further adapter and applicability review
coverage.scope: Selected important families with primary sources. This living catalog is not all techniques in existence and absence never proves novelty.

evaluation_cautions.finding: A 2026 FP4-attention preprint reports divergence in every tested distributed MXFP4 probability/value trajectory despite kernel or one-update gains.
evaluation_cautions.implication: Require sustained training stability; classify this fresh result as preliminary, not a universal FP4 conclusion.

evaluation_cautions.finding: Standard low-rank LoRA can learn less than full finetuning while forgetting less.
evaluation_cautions.implication: Adaptation capacity, retention and memory are distinct axes; a memory win cannot certify full-training equivalence.

evaluation_cautions.finding: Official DCLM correction makes pre- and post-September-2025 centered CORE/EXTENDED values directly incomparable without re-evaluation.
evaluation_cautions.implication: Freeze evaluator/calibration revisions; do not pool published scores across this boundary.

evaluation_cautions.finding: Additional latent iterations can revise correct easy-token predictions into errors.
evaluation_cautions.implication: Use constant/random routing and an oracle-bound diagnostic before investing in a learned halting controller.

evaluation_cautions.finding: Keeping parameters and data fixed does not keep recurrence FLOPs fixed.
evaluation_cautions.implication: Separate parameter-efficiency evidence from training-compute efficiency.

interaction_risks: Sparse masks, quantized KV and speculative trees need compatible kernels; their names do not establish composition.
limitations: Kernel speed is not end-to-end speed; decoding can remain weight-bandwidth limited.

techniques.model_changes: No retraining for dense-kernel replacement.
techniques.name: IO-aware tiled dense-attention kernels
techniques.semantic_effect: Dense mathematical attention is preserved; floating-point ordering, low precision and exponential approximations require numerical qualification, not bitwise-equivalence claims.

interaction_risks: Quantized layouts, eviction, prefix sharing and rollback must agree on block ownership and layout.
limitations: Benefits depend on fragmentation, sequence lengths and usable batch capacity.
techniques.local_scope_note: No exposed or validated PagedAttention allocator intervention; ordinary cache presence is insufficient.

prerequisites: Reference counting and copy-on-write cache ownership
techniques.semantic_effect: Memory placement can preserve the same attention computation; scheduling and numerical kernels still require parity checks.

applicability: Mixed prefill/decode traffic and bursty arrivals
interaction_risks: Speculation consumes additional verification tokens; prefix hits alter prefill demand; disaggregation changes scheduler economics.
limitations: Throughput gains can trade against TTFT or tail latency; workload arrival process matters.

techniques.model_changes: None required.
techniques.name: Iteration scheduling, continuous batching and chunked prefill
techniques.semantic_effect: Scheduling preserves request semantics in principle; finite-precision batch-shape changes can affect greedy results.

applicability: Repeated system prompts, conversation branches and shared document prefixes
interaction_risks: Model changes, KV formats and positional transformations invalidate keys; speculative rollback must preserve committed prefixes.
limitations: Low overlap, eviction or short prefills can erase the benefit; caching does not accelerate all decode work.
techniques.local_scope_note: Only cache_prompt false/true with explicit slots and reconciled token counts is admitted; this is not SGLang/RadixAttention support.
techniques.mechanism: Exact token-prefix KV reuse and cache-aware request placement

applicability: Multi-device services with different prefill/decode demands
interaction_risks: KV quantization, MLA, cache pages and model revisions must agree across endpoints.
limitations: Transport, duplication and queue costs can exceed saved interference; Lynx is author-reported preprint evidence.
techniques.local_scope_note: Single-host pinned CPU experiments expose neither distributed placement nor KV transfer.
techniques.mechanism: Disaggregated prefill/decode with explicit KV transport
techniques.model_changes: None inherently required.
techniques.name: Disaggregated prefill/decode with explicit KV transport

interaction_risks: AWQ and activation-quantization transforms need joint calibration; an exact verifier using quantized target weights preserves that target, not original FP16.
limitations: Quality, speed and memory depend on bit width, grouping, calibration and kernel implementation.

techniques.mechanism: Activation-aware low-bit weight quantization
techniques.model_changes: New quantized artifact and calibration provenance; no backpropagation required by AWQ.
techniques.name: Activation-aware low-bit weight quantization
prerequisites: Matching packed-weight format and efficient dequantization/matmul kernels
techniques.semantic_effect: Approximate relative to original FP16 weights; comparable benchmark quality is not identical outputs.

interaction_risks: Weight-only quantization, LoRA and normalization fusions change calibration or scale placement.
